Sri Ramakrishna College of Arts and Science for Women is committed to total quality in education, pursuing higher academic standards, expanding knowledge, building skills, fostering values and developing holistic personalities for empowering women to meet global challenges.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Quality Policy

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - UG Degree]
The candidates who have passed Higher Secondary Examination conducted by the Government of Tamil Nadu or an equivalent examinations shall be eligible to join the first year of the UG degree courses, subject to the stipulation that the candidates satisfy certain specific conditions, if any, prescribed by the University for admission to the respective courses.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - UG Degree

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - PG Degree]
The candidates, who have passed Under-graduate degree course of Bharathiar University or an equivalent examination, shall be eligible to join the first year of PG Degree courses in this College, subject to the condition that the candidates should satisfy certain other specific conditions prescribed, if any, by the University for admission to the respective courses.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - PG Degree

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Foreign Students]
Foreign students getting admitted to the college should have a valid visa (student's visa/provisional student's visa) to be eligible for admission and to undergo the study in India. The students will have to obtain clearance from the Registrar-Bharathiar University for confirmation of admission.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Foreign Students

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Research]
Ph.D. Selection of research candidates are on the basis of merit, performance in CET conducted by Bharathiar University and interview. Students who have cleared common eligibility tests conducted by state agencies such as SET and national agencies such as UGC NET/UGC-CSIR-NET/GATE are exempted from CET for admission into Ph.D Programmes. Based on the selection list the students are interviewed on the date of admission, all original documents are verified and students are admitted to the corresponding programmes offered by the institution.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Research

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Differently Abled]
Differently abled students are given special care and attention. Ramp facilities, wheel-chair facilities, classrooms and rest-rooms are specially provided in the ground-floor for their usage.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Differently Abled

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Sports]
Athletes and outstanding sports persons are given first preference and fee concession by the management during admission. They are also provided with TA, DA and sports uniform for participating in sports meets. Necessary weightage is given during admissions to students under sports category.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Sports

text:
[SRCW | SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Scholarship]
A transparent admission is carried out with equal opportunities to the socially disadvantaged sections of the society namely minority and SC/ST. The Institution provides merit scholarship, alumni scholarship and fee concession for the employees of SNR Trust.
source_title: SRCW | UG Admission | PG Admission - Scholarship

[SRCW Official FAQ: About SRCW Overview and Accreditation]
Sri Ramakrishna College of Arts & Science for Women (SRCW), Coimbatore was established in 1991 by SNR Sons Charitable Trust. The institution is affiliated with Bharathiar University and is an Autonomous institution reaccredited by NAAC with an 'A+' Grade. SRCW is an ISO certified premier women's institution dedicated to women empowerment through holistic education, state-of-the-art infrastructure, value-based learning, and academic excellence. Tagline: "Educate to Empower".
